scope: Identity/assay provenance only, no case biomarker values or outcome cells.

new_TF2026_letter.interpretation: Short primary research letter with direct main-text paragraphs; detailed methods and identity roster in supplementary material. Section-only absence is not missing main text.

new_TF2026_supplement.unit: Aggregate diagnostic strata, not individual donor IDs/serial draws.

literal_primary_method_access_excerpts.quote: The concentration of extracted cfDNA was determined via RT-qPCR using an 81 bp amplicon of the EIF2C1 gene on chromosome 1 and a dilution series of placenta DNA.
Prior to testing the cfDNA samples, sensitivity assays were conducted using tumor and blood DNA to determine the limits of detection of mutant DNA for each case.
The levels of circulating biomarkers were taken at the time of diagnosis of first pleural involvement.
The raw data supporting the conclusions of this article will be made available by the authors, without undue reservation.
The datasets generated and/or analysed during the current study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
